search_window.basis: Previous independently fetched Food Line watch heartbeat through this run. Search retrieval also allowed recent prior-days reporting to catch indexing delay, but only new impacts since the prior completion qualify.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; Food Line production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Community's only/sole/last/full-service grocery store lost to closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution cancelled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food bank shutdown or major food-access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
search_queries: "only grocery store" closed fire November 14 2026 town
SNAP WIC EBT benefits outage interruption November 14 2026 state agency
coverage_notes.search_limitations: Targeted news search predominantly found older closures, scheduled distributions, and historical SNAP reports. Local notices published within an hour may not yet be indexed. This bounded watch is not exhaustive.

failures.impact: Recurring Guam official-notice retrieval restriction; search used as imperfect substitute.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Spencer, NY only-grocery-store fire reported September 14, not new in November 14 observation window.
Provo food bank temporary closure was published November 3, before this observation window.
Colorado grocery closure story published October 13, not new in current hourly window.
Connecticut EBT processor conversion scheduled November 15, 05:00–17:00 UTC; not yet an active disruption. Status page reports all systems operational and no November 14 incidents.
Oregon SNAP proof-of-housing/utility-cost requirements start November 21; no observed immediate interruption.
Two Rhode Island DHS offices under remote-service model for pest treatment; alternative appointment/portal/call-center access remains; no new confirmed interruption during this window.
Routine November 14 scheduled distribution, not cancellation.
November 13 page revision presents normal food-finding/distribution information, not a newly documented suspension.

coverage_notes.baseline_comparison: 11 of the same 15 recurring direct sources accessible, with four unchanged restrictions (Guam, two USDA pages, Maine); no newly material deterioration from verified 03:44 PST heartbeat.
coverage_notes.exclusions_policy: Excluded donations, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine program promotion, generic inflation, historic/duplicate incidents and future policy changes without immediate access loss.
coverage_notes.operations: No approval, publication, schedule alteration, automation disabling or production modification.
